overview: Faith-based coffee shop website for Overflow of Jo inside Wave Wilson Church, with an admin panel for managing menu, images, Instagram embeds, form submissions, and inline text editing.
features: Public site with hero, about, menu, events, prayer requests, scripture, and Instagram embeds
Admin panel with menu management, site images, find us online, form submissions, and inline editor tabs
Toggle-based inline text editing inside an embedded site view within the admin panel
Content overrides persisted to the backend as a semantic key-to-text map
Interactive OpenStreetMap with Nominatim geocoding for the events location
